name: ht
description: LUMINA Fine Dining & Lounge Web Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public','dist'].forEach(dir => { if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir); ['index.html','menu.html','gallery.html','contact.html','favicon.svg','robots.txt','sitemap.xml'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, dir+'/'+f)); ['css','js'].forEach(d => { if(fs.existsSync(d)) { if(!fs.existsSync(dir+'/'+d)) fs.mkdirSync(dir+'/'+d); fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(d+'/'+f, dir+'/'+d+'/'+f)); } }); });"
